paths_relative_to: workspace root (the folder that contains sutro/ and sutro-dataset/)

datasets.name: khatian_form5462 pages + tables
datasets.task: khatian page OCR / field extraction; paired survey versions (CS/SA/RS/BS) per land with transition ground truth
datasets.format: JPEG pages in pages/{train,val,test}; annotations.jsonl (field text + polygon, lines); CSV tables lands, khatians, owners, dag_rows, title_line
datasets.labels: field text and polygon per field; owner share_exact (fraction) and share_printed_3dp; dag rows; transition label + detail_json between consecutive versions; split by land
datasets.provenance: generated by build/khatian_data.py, khatian_render.py, build_khatian.py; 4 Bengali fonts (nirmala 2353, notosans 1453, notoserif 1131, hind 857); every record has synthetic=true; layout is an invented Form-5462-style page, not a government form
datasets.licence: not stated in DATASET_CARD.md (card predates this folder); synthetic/ parts are MIT
datasets.notes: RS and BS records are paired: every BS khatian has an RS predecessor (1139 RS>BS links). No real RS/BS khatian dataset is publicly available (KhatianDoc Hugging Face repo empty on 2026-10-15).

datasets.name: khatian_form5462 ocr_cells
datasets.task: text-line OCR (CRNN + CTC) on synthetic khatian cells
datasets.format: PNG crops, height 40 px, in {train,val,test}/; labels.csv (file,text,field_type,page_id,split)
datasets.provenance: cut from the synthetic pages above
datasets.notes: font-rendered text, not handwriting; accuracy on real scans not measurable from this data

datasets.name: ocr_cells_packed
datasets.format: cells_{train,val,test}.npz (data uint8 strip (40, W) + widths int32) and cells_{split}.csv (text,field_type,page_id)
datasets.provenance: built by build/pack_cells.py; cells_train.npz sha256 85f79ae57be618a7bae37f15b72f8cb5699bb5d82c7a53f9a9850474e261e3c3 (as recorded by the smoke run)
datasets.notes: this is what the Kaggle CRNN run reads

datasets.name: synthetic packets
datasets.task: evidence-engine evaluation: case packets with injected faults and expected findings

datasets.provenance: generated by build/gen_packets.py; verified against sutro/js/engine.js by build/verify_packets.js (generator-vs-engine self-consistency, not real-world accuracy)
datasets.notes: all names, numbers and offices invented

datasets.name: NumtaDB digits (converted)
datasets.format: numta_32x32.npz (x_train, y_train, d_train, x_val, y_val, d_val) + numta_32x32.json
datasets.provenance: Kaggle BengaliAI/numta (NumtaDB), converted by build/convert_numta.py (grayscale, 32x32 bilinear, inverted); npz sha256 67e3ede9263784fad195f00c4f8683a38d142a9dc69e46f19d561c0eb21bc9a1 (as recorded by the smoke run); raw zip in raw/numta (about 1955 MiB)
datasets.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (ShareAlike applies to the npz and to trained weights)
datasets.notes: public open data; measures digit recognition only, not land verification

datasets.name: DIU Bangla Handwritten Dolil deeds (converted)
datasets.format: JPEG scans in {train,val,test}/, long side <= 1600 px; manifest.csv (file,split,orig_w,orig_h,w,h,sha256_original)
datasets.provenance: Mendeley Data doi:10.17632/yk3c3xy9vm.1 (DIU authors), converted by build/convert_dolil.py; originals in raw/dolil (about 2219 MiB); contents not opened during this audit
datasets.notes: real handwritten land deeds that may contain personal data; rulebook section 8 requires full anonymisation and prior organiser approval; keep out of the website, repo, demo and any shared bundle. Also present inside sutro-dataset.zip, which therefore must not be published.
